min_standing_note.value: Undergraduate level; must have completed at least 1 semester at home university with official grades available.

english_course_availability.notes: Fact Sheet states: 'About 90% of all courses at APU are held in both English and Japanese'.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: For non-native English/Japanese students choosing English-basis: TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS 6.0, TOEIC L&R 780, PTE Academic 50, or Cambridge FCE Grade B. No RHET 1020 waiver stated.
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=3

host_language_requirement.value: Japanese-basis students require JLPT N1 (>=100), JLPT N2 (>=135), or EJU >=250; none required for English-basis exchange students.
host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=3

fall_term_dates.value: Fall Semester: official period Sep 21 – Mar 31 (arrival/orientation mid-late Sep; classes Oct – early Feb across Q1 & Q2).
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=5

spring_term_dates.value: Spring Semester: official period Apr 1 – Sep 20 (arrival/orientation mid-late Mar; classes Apr – early Aug across Q1 & Q2).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/APU Information Sheet for AY2025 Spring Exchange Program.pdf#page=3

tuition_model.notes: Official en.apu.ac.jp confirms incoming partner exchange students are exempt from application, admission, and tuition fees.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=9
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Summed from APU itemized Fact Sheet budgets over 5-month semester: AP House 3/4 (~230,000–300,000 JPY/sem = 46,000–60,000 JPY/mo), food (30,000–50,000 JPY/mo), transport (~50,000 JPY/sem = 10,000 JPY/mo; web lists 45,000–75,000 JPY/sem), books/academic (10,000–20,000 JPY/sem = 2,000–4,000 JPY/mo), and other personal (10,000 JPY/mo per Spring 2025 Fact Sheet #page=7).

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=9
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate in JPY: midpoint 116000 JPY/month * 5 * 0.006250 USD/JPY = 3625.04 USD (1 EUR = 1.1052 USD and 1 EUR = 176.83 JPY -> 1 JPY = 0.006250 USD; ECB 2026-11-13 reference rate collected 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html). Summed from APU itemized Fact Sheet budgets over 5-month semester: AP House 3/4 (~230,000–300,000 JPY/sem = 46,000–60,000 JPY/mo), food (30,000–50,000 JPY/mo), transport (~50,000 JPY/sem = 10,000 JPY/mo; web lists 45,000–75,000 JPY/sem), books/academic (10,000–20,000 JPY/sem = 2,000–4,000 JPY/mo), and other personal (10,000 JPY/mo per Spring 2025 Fact Sheet #page=7).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Compulsory Japan National Health Insurance (~JPY 14,000/sem Fall 2025, ~JPY 10,000/sem Spring 2025) plus Student's Comprehensive Renters Insurance (~JPY 3,000/sem per Spring 2025 #page=8).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=9

housing_availability.notes: Official en.apu.ac.jp and Fall 2025 Fact Sheet (#page=9) confirm designated AP House 3 or AP House 4 accommodation is provided/guaranteed for all exchange students (no other housing options allowed).

housing_notes.value: Students choose AP House 3 (~JPY 230,000/sem) or AP House 4 (~JPY 300,000/sem; ~5-month package incl. rent, utilities, move-in fee, bedding), paid by lump-sum bank wire prior to arrival; no other housing allowed.
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=9

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Japanese Student Visa obtained prior to arrival using APU-applied Certificate of Eligibility (CoE) (1-yr visa for 1 sem, 1-yr-3-mo for 1 yr); Work Permit takes ~2 weeks after Residence Card.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=10

exchange_page_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=1

course_catalog_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=1

english_course_list_url.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=1
english_course_list_url.notes: APU offers ~90% of courses in both English and Japanese; see also 2025 Fall Enrollment Restricted Language Courses.pdf.

credit_system_and_load.value: Japanese credits (major/liberal arts = 2 credits; language = 2 or 4 credits); visa requires minimum 14 credits/sem AND >=10 class hrs/week (typical load 18–20).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=8

course_restrictions_note.value: Students must select 1 affiliated college (APS, APM, or ST, #page=5-6); English/Japanese language courses restricted by study basis and placement test (2025 Fall Restricted Language Courses.pdf#page=1).
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=5

international_support_services.value: Airport pick-up service, mandatory pre-term orientation, APU BUDDY system (#page=5 & #page=10).
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=5

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall: Nomination Apr 1, Application Apr 22; Spring: Nomination Oct 1, Application Oct 22.
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Ritsumeikan Asia Pacific University (APU)/(Fall 2025) APU Student Exchange Program_Fall 2025 Information Sheet.pdf#page=3
